semantic.justification: Task76 in progress: original clipboard ResetClip/InitClipPtrs and SharePooledResources retain genuine pool/string/attribute helper identities,source option values and sparse selected-sheet indexes. Clear releases actual formula and attribute owners before sheet removal. Native column4 CloneFormulaCell creates shared code once per shareable span,bulk-inserts actual typed storage and joins boundaries. Default CONTENTS CopyFromClipContext retains native cursor caches,cell values,metadata and deferred listening spans;single-cell column replication handles represented values,strings,empty and grouped formulas. Original temporary/inserting document guards suppress premature subscriptions and broadcasts. No browser fill loop,formula-text reparse,alternate workbook or simulated physical refcount is introduced. Document-level paste/reference completion,real paste undo and EnterBlock/UI acceptance are still pending;this progress record does not certify task76 or full native parity. The unchanged native GetSelectionFrame definition was partitioned onto the same ScDocument instance through documen7 alongside existing out-of-class document.cxx definitions to keep document.ts below1000 authored lines;no additional state or frame contract was introduced. Task76 pre-paste deletion progress ports SingleColumnSpanSet set/getSpans/swap/empty and the ColumnSpanSet single-column overload;native DeleteCells captures actual formula group extents before shared-context teardown and explicit broadcaster purge,then splits top/bottom boundaries and empties real typed stores in reverse span order. Original document10/table7/column4 pre-deletion cycles sparse source tabs and columns,visits allocated destinations only,and defers broadcasts/listener restoration to CopyFromClipContext. Default CONTENTS preserves destination patterns. Native toSpanArray is reused. Selective date/number deletion requires the unported formatter;skip-empty,nondefault flags and absent rich-edit/note/sparkline stores remain explicit. CellStorageModified formula-group compute cache and stream-valid notifications are unrepresented rather than simulated. Full document copy/paste/reference completion,paste Undo/Redo,EnterBlock and browser acceptance remain pending;this is not task76 completion or full parity. These additions supersede only earlier omissions of these specific pre-deletion/span/listener methods;unconsumed overloads and broader parity remain unverified. Task76 general-copy progress ports original CopyCellsFromClipHandler and CopyTextAttrsFromClipHandler with real typed source blocks,two content/metadata passes,independent native cursor values,context writeback and foreign string re-interning. ScColumn scalar/hinted SetValue/SetRawString/SetFormulaCell overloads retain native defaults,return contracts,broadcast controls and actual group/listener owners. Table2 CopyFromClip validates/clamps the destination and dispatches actual source columns;CONTENTS preserves destination patterns and geometry. ParseBlock now represents its actual container-event template and borrowed node fields;bounded ProcessFormula dispatches real formula pointers and separate non-formula spans. Original column/table/document SetDirtyFromClip,rectangular individual/area BroadcastCells and deferred BroadcastAction use existing bulk owners and actual subscriptions;cached formula results are dirtied only in completion. Matrix,foreign-pool formulas,number-format inheritance,full formatter/notes/edit/drawing services,group-compute cache invalidation and shell/UNO stream notifications remain unrepresented. Native general document/reference orchestration,paste undo/redo and EnterBlock/UI acceptance remain pending;this is not full task76 acceptance or full parity. Task76 adds original CopyBlockFromClip source-sheet cycling,selected actual destinations and consecutive-sheet reference updates through the shared block-position cache. CopyNonFilteredFromClip uses the first populated clipboard sheet,actual FilterData segments and original SCROW-max output/count behavior (CALC-261). FilterData::firstNonFilteredRow retains initialized native-domain semantics;its segment partition is total for every valid row,so allocator/corrupt-store lookup failures are not simulated. Same-pool cut/move remains an explicit admission boundary before payload mutation;foreign-pool cut retains the native skipped-reference phase. Context admission is still default CONTENTS;drawing/non-content services are not represented. DeleteSelection is partitioned unchanged onto the same ScDocument instance to preserve the file-size limit. Full document CopyFromClip,single-row optimization,Undo initialization/history and EnterBlock remain pending;no whole-module parity promotion. Task76 adds original InitUndo,InitUndoSelected and AddUndoTab with source-shared pooled resources,empty native names,sparse actual sheet vectors and false/false geometry defaults. ScTable now allocates genuine column width/flag and row height/flag owners independently under original constructor defaults true/true;no fake geometry buffers are allocated when disabled. Native width/height getters,mutators and geometry-copy guards honor actual absent stores. Borrowed browser geometry-range helpers,CopyRowHeight and optimal-height calculation keep their original allocated-geometry caller precondition;casts preserve that boundary without inventing absent ranges. GetClipArea is partitioned unchanged on the same document instance. Empty selected initialization keeps the original one-null-slot result (CALC-262). Source shell-medium URL propagation and unrepresented formatter/drawing/printing services remain unported;native paste history,document CopyFromClip,single-row script/format services and EnterBlock are still pending. No whole-module parity promotion.
